europe_now.title: Romanian nuclear shutdown and Danube drying highlight European environmental crisis
europe_now.summary: Romania has closed its sole nuclear power plant as extreme heat reduces the Danube River’s flow to historic lows. The dual disruptions threaten regional energy security and agricultural water supplies.

europe_now.title: EU gas storage concerns spark winter price spiral warnings
europe_now.summary: EU gas inventories are currently low, raising concerns about winter supply stability. Analysts warn that reduced inventories could trigger a price spiral as demand peaks during colder months.

top_stories.title: EU energy security faces winter price spiral risk
top_stories.summary: EU gas storage levels are currently low, raising concerns about winter supply stability. Analysts warn that reduced inventories could trigger a price spiral as demand peaks during colder months.

top_stories.title: European environmental crisis includes nuclear shutdown and river drought
top_stories.summary: Romania has shut down its only nuclear power plant while Hungary’s dam operations have reduced the Danube River’s flow to historic lows. The dual disruptions threaten energy generation and agricultural water supplies across the region.

top_stories.title: Ukraine conflict continues to cause civilian casualties
top_stories.summary: A Russian strike on a Ukrainian passenger train killed two civilians, highlighting the ongoing cross-border impact of the conflict. The incident adds to mounting civilian casualties that have reached their highest level since 2022.
